title: CIS-1200 (T-230-1A 'Mahovik')
short: CIS-1200, Mahovik, "Flywheel" in Russian, is a PSK based mode that can transmit both voice and data. It is transmitted from a Russian T-230-1A.
desc: **CIS-1200 (T-230-1A Маховик)**, or "**Flywheel**" in Russian, is a PSK based mode that can transmit both voice and data. It is transmitted from a Russian T-230-1A. Has been seen with both BPSK and SDPSK manipulation at 1200Bd.
